primary_question: Do iterative pre-index refinements produce coherent comparison cohorts and how do observed subsequent treatment and renal trajectories differ?
sample: deterministic patient hash, or all if fewer; no post-index outcome selection
index: 24 elapsed hours after first observed mapped antibiotic administration in admission
eligibility: adult under reviewed source age policy
at least one eligible creatinine within 48 pre-index hours

outcomes.renal: max observed creatinine in first 48 post-index hours minus minimum eligible baseline in 48 pre-index hours; retain missing
outcomes.treatment: documented subsequent administrations or supported changes; no inferred cessation from gaps

split: patient-level development/evaluation before tuning; QA patients stay development
